summary.intent: Execute the GSD manager workflow for the CipherBox v1.1 milestone to discuss, plan, and fully execute phases 42 (API unpin integrity), 43 (FUSE write durability), and 44 (IPNS conflict handling) — three UAT gap-closure phases from PR #484.
summary.outcome: Phase 42 was fully completed (8 plans across 3 waves, code review, verification passed, todos closed). Phase 43 was fully executed (4 plans across 3 waves, code review done) but verification returned 'gaps_found' status. Phase 44 was only discussed and had CONTEXT.md written; planning and execution did not start within the session.

repo: The unpin endpoint (POST /ipfs/unpin) had no ownership check — any valid JWT could unpin any CID since signup is open (Web3Auth). Kubo API port 5001 is loopback-only since Phase 29, making the API endpoint the sole entry point.

Kubo runs with the 'server' profile (docker/docker-compose.staging.yml:62-72) which keeps full public DHT participation and broadcasts provider records for every pinned CID — blobs are encrypted but CIDs are publicly discoverable.
shared-write.ts:450 drops prunedCids without calling unpin — writable-share saves have a pre-existing prunedCids leak that is separate from the unpin integrity bug.

All current callers ignore unpin errors: web uses .catch(logger.warn), FUSE uses 'let _ ='. This means silent 2XX is backward-compatible but 403 would generate warning-log noise in the Phase 30 observability pipeline.
BYO-IPFS unpin was broken in both directions (provider.unpin not wired into delete flows); new server-side semantics fixed it for free as a side effect of guardedUnpin.

cargo build -p cipherbox-fuse --features winfsp cannot pass on macOS due to pre-existing cross-compilation failures in windows-future and winfsp-sys registry crates — these are unrelated to FUSE durability changes and were present before Phase 43.
The gsd commit helper returns 'committed: false' as a false negative (commit actually lands) — always verify with git log, never blind-retry.
The repo had no .prettierignore, causing prettier to mangle planning docs and VALIDATION.md markdown tables (pipes interpreted as table columns, breaking regex patterns).
1Password SSH signing is enforced on PRs. Commits in sandboxed subagents require dangerouslyDisableSandbox: true, and signing failures require restarting the 1Password desktop app.

code.finding: Kubo v0.40 uses 'server' profile with swarm port 4001 exposed publicly (tcp+udp). Server profile only disables local-network discovery; full public DHT participation is retained, broadcasting provider records for all pinned CIDs.

Upload compensation path fires a global pin/rm on a CID that may be content-addressed shared with another user — no refcount check. This was fixed in Phase 42 by routing compensation through guardedUnpin.

guardedUnpin added with pg_advisory_xact_lock(hashtext(cid)), transactional row-delete+refcount+outbox (pending_unpins table), Kubo pin/rm post-commit best-effort, and cross-user audit metric increment. Closes the ownership gap.

Fully rewritten in Phase 43: JournalOp, JournalEntryStatus, JournalEntry, WriteQueue with put/remove/load_all_for_vault/update_status/record_failure/ordered_for_replay. Journal-fsync-before-ack ordering enforced.
handle_release reordered: journal.put(844) → handle.cleanup(892) → reply.ok(894) → spawn(904) → journal.remove-on-success(943). This enforces durability-before-ack semantics per Phase 43 D-04/D-05.

workflow: The gsd worktree cleanup helper (worktree.cleanup-wave) must be run from the repo root, not from inside an agent worktree. Running it from a worktree path causes false base_mismatch errors because the helper resolves repoRoot from cwd.
cleanup-wave is not idempotent: already-merged entries report branch_mismatch on rerun. Workaround: write reduced manifests containing only the remaining unmerged entries.

Worktree merges block on untracked directories (node_modules, .husky/_). These must be removed before cleanup-wave runs. Later executor prompts included explicit CLEANUP instructions to prevent recurrence.
When an agent worktree merge leaves MERGE_HEAD (all conflicts auto-resolved but commit step failed), 'git commit --no-edit' concludes the merge cleanly.

openapi.json can accumulate formatting-only drift from 'nest build' side effects (564+ lines changed, semantics unchanged). Restore with 'git checkout -- packages/api-client/openapi.json' before merging executor worktrees to avoid false-positive diffs.

pnpm test flag forwarding is broken: 'pnpm --filter @pkg test -- --testPathPattern=X' causes pnpm to insert an extra '--', making jest treat the pattern flag as a positional regex. Use 'pnpm --filter @pkg exec jest --testPathPattern=X' instead.

Decision coverage gate uses mechanical grep for literal 'D-07:' citation strings in plan must_haves — a missing citation fails the gate even if the decision is satisfied implicitly. Plans must include explicit D-xx truth lines.

GSD phase branches (feat/phase-name) are created and managed automatically. When chaining phases, the prior phase's branch must be rebased onto the completed work before planning starts (rebase feat/fuse-write-durability onto feat/api-unpin-integrity after phase 42 completed).

friction: 1Password SSH signing failed mid-session (agent returned an error / fatal: failed to write commit object), requiring user to restart the 1Password desktop app. Repeated across multiple plan/commit cycles.
gsd commit helper false negatives ('committed: false' while commit actually landed) caused unnecessary retry attempts and verification overhead.
pnpm test double-dash flag forwarding bug caused multiple test invocation failures before the 'exec jest' workaround was discovered.
Planner agent hit a socket error mid-run after writing plans 01-03, requiring a filesystem check and continuation planner spawn for plans 04-08.
cleanup-wave not being idempotent required writing reduced manifests on reruns — brittle when merges partially succeed.
openapi.json formatting drift from nest build blocked worktree merges and required manual restoration.
Missing .prettierignore caused prettier to corrupt VALIDATION.md and planning markdown tables; discovered only after a table-mangled test command broke a test run.
Session context limit hit twice, requiring a summary-based continuation handoff.
Accidental user text input ('touring wyatt web bossy') caused two task interruptions mid-wave execution.
Phase 43 verification returned 'gaps_found' despite all 4 plans completing successfully — the exact gaps are not enumerated in the transcript.
open_items: Phase 43 verification has 'gaps_found' status — gap closure plans need to be created and executed before phase 43 can be marked complete.
Phase 44 (IPNS conflict handling) — CONTEXT.md and DISCUSSION-LOG.md were written but planning and execution did not start.
Security gate flagged for Phase 42: SECURITY.md is missing; /gsd-secure-phase 42 must be run.
BYO provider.unpin client wiring was deferred to a future phase (not in Phase 42 scope).
Pending-uploads UI (parked uploads list with count/status) was noted as a future improvement, deferred from Phase 43 scope.
Writable-share prunedCids leak (shared-write.ts:450 drops pruned CIDs without unpinning) was identified but deferred.
Rust FUSE merge conflict parity equivalent to Phase 44 TypeScript three-way merge was deferred.
Phase 43 node_modules symlink workaround used by executor (created temporarily to unblock lint-staged, then removed) — root cause of why the pre-commit hook needed it should be investigated.
